card.name: Ending of the word ophthalmic
card.fires_on: The final piece "ic" completing the word "ophthalmic" in eye-drop drug names, right before "solution". It almost never fires on other words.

modes.label: Ophthalmic before solution
modes.description: The "ic" that completes "ophthalmic" in an eye-drop product name, just before "Solution".
modes.example: The usual dose is one drop of Carteolol Hydrochloride Ophthalm<<ic>> Solution 1% in the affected eye
